item.title: Official barber of the Seattle Seahawks packs his clippers for Super Bowl 2026
item.description: Before the Seattle Seahawks take the field for the Super Bowl, many are planning to make one stop: to see their barber.

item.title: WA proposal wants to allow sports betting on in-state college teams
item.description: Some lawmakers in Olympia want to expand sports wagering in Washington, allowing bets on in-state college teams that are currently prohibited under state law.

item.title: 2 shot, killed at bus stop in Seattle's Rainier Beach neighborhood
item.description: Seattle police are investigating after two people were shot and killed near a bus stop in the Rainier Beach neighborhood on Friday afternoon.

item.title: Logan Evans to miss 2026 season after Tommy John surgery for Seattle Mariners
item.description: Seattle Mariners right-hander Logan Evans is expected to miss the 2026 season after undergoing right elbow surgery, general manager Justin Hollander said Friday.

item.title: Kenneth Walker III is firing on all cylinders ahead of possible last game with Seattle Seahawks
item.description: Seahawks running back Kenneth Walker III has surged with fellow tailback Zach Charbonnet out with a season-ending knee injury. But Walker is also in the final year of his rookie contract.

item.title: Anti-ICE protesters occupy University of Washington building
item.description: Hundreds of protesters briefly occupied Gerberding Hall at the University of Washington as part of a nationwide anti-ICE movement.

item.title: Seattle Mayor, police guild spar over ICE protection directives
item.description: The Seattle Police Officers Guild is refusing to cooperate with a recent directive from Mayor Katie Wilson ordering officers to investigate and document ICE activity in the city.

item.title: Seattle protesters join national ‘ICE Out’ day of action
item.description: Dozens of protesters gathered in downtown Seattle for a national “ICE Out” day of action targeting corporate ties to immigration enforcement.

item.title: Starbucks feels the heat as more chains compete for US coffee drinkers
item.description: Seattle-based Starbucks was a small, regional chain when former CEO Howard Schultz acquired it in 1987 and made it a global brand. Now, other small chains are seeing explosive growth.

item.title: Amanda Knox talks new documentary, facing the person who put her in prison
item.description: Amanda Knox and her husband, Christopher Robinson, are releasing a new documentary that revisits her wrongful conviction in Italy.
